purpose.zh: 活动髋部和腰部，久坐后快速放松
purpose.en: Loosen up your hips and lower back after sitting.

text.zh: 双脚踩稳，骨盆慢慢画大圈
text.en: Keep your feet planted and draw big, slow circles with your pelvis

text.zh: 双脚略比髋宽，膝盖微屈，双手叉腰
text.en: Stand with feet a little wider than your hips, knees soft, hands on hips.

text.zh: 肩膀尽量保持水平，一个方向画完再反方向
text.en: Keep your shoulders fairly level, then reverse the direction.

commonErrors.zh: 用上身甩动代替骨盆画圈
commonErrors.en: Swinging the upper body instead of moving the pelvis.

cautions.zh: 腰部疼痛时缩小画圈幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Make smaller circles if your lower back hurts, and stop if the pain continues.
